prior_year_events.impact_description: Regulators highlighted potential opioid exposures; the Syndicate holds a separate reserve in Solvency II to anticipate opioid claims and considers latent liabilities when setting reserves.

prior_year_events.event_name: Favourable claims developments in 2021 (impacting prior years)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Reduction in the estimate of 2018 and prior years' liability reserves as a result of favourable claims developments in 2021 (reported by the managing agent).

data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development triangle the Syndicate recorded a net favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 10.16m (a c.3.8% release of opening gross reserves), driven mainly by favourable development across older liability and property years, partially offset by deterioration in the 2019 column. The report attributes reserve strength and subsequent movements to latent US liability exposures, vigilance on social inflation and litigation trends (including opioid-related concerns), and explicit cautious reserving margins above actuarial best estimates.
raw_causal_phrases: reduction in the estimate of 2018 and prior years' liability reserves as a result of favourable claims developments in 2021
favourable development of paid and incurred claims during 2021
This margin above the net earned best estimate of technical provisions amounted to GBP 106.2 million as at 31 December 2021

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross amounts in GBP '000 converted to millions). The Notes provide a 'Significant movements' table for net (after reinsurance) movements by class which was used for LOB-level direction and amounts (net), because gross per-LOB prior-year movements were not separately disclosed. RITC and Part VII transfers are discussed in the report and can distort comparisons; triangle method applied excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2021 and 2020) per standard rules. Amounts and classification for LOB movements are therefore of lower confidence (net figures) and are flagged above.
